waiting.note: session_start is waiting before the first prompt; agent_settled is the strongest idle signal after retries, compaction, and queued work settle

attentionRequired.note: No native permission-dialog or attention event was observed; do not infer it from tool failure or provider error

identity.session: extension context exposes session manager identity; event envelope itself does not add a provider-specific id
identity.cwd: extension context cwd is available but not included in the observed event payloads
